title: H 3003 (120th General Assembly): Voting identification
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) SECTION 1 (amends 7-13-710(A), item (6))
(quote) a college or university identification card containing a photograph
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) SECTION 1 also moves 'or' so it follows item (5) and removes it from earlier items (list punctuation only).
(other) SECTION 2: takes effect upon approval by the Governor.
(other) version: 2012-12-11_Introduced (only version): adds a photo college or university ID as item (6) to the post-Act 27 ID list in 7-13-710(A) (driver's license, DMV photo ID, passport, military ID, voter registration card with photo), all 'valid and current'. No slot b, c or d text.
(other) note: Amends 7-13-710(A) as last amended by Act 27 of 2011. One version; no floor action found in the saved record.
